feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 11 September 2026 4:11pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 11 September 2026 at 4:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds for a time.


##Synopsis##

Ridge across the area will soon decline, with Atlantic fronts arriving later tonight.


##Wind##

West 3 or 4, backing South or Southwest and increasing 4 or 5 this evening, then further increasing 6 or 7 overnight, although staying a force or two lighter in Liverpool Bay. Little change tomorrow morning, them veering West 5 occasionally 6 in afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building moderate or rough overnight, becoming mainly moderate tomorrow afternoon.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain and drizzle later tonight and at first tomorrow.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain and drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 5 occasionally 6, gradually decreasing West or Northwest 3 or 4 through tomorrow evening, then 2 or 3 overnight into Sunday. Backing Southwest 2 or 3 by Sunday afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, falling smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
